messages:
samir: Heads-up — can we get a small Grafana dashboard for handling thermal hysteresis + tenant slotting? Seeing weird cycles where racks run hot for ~10m then drop and we evict, but tenant billing still counts full slot. Want visibility + an alert suggestion.

gabi: +1. Maybe a combined panel showing 95p util, inlet temp, fan %, and a tenant-allocated vs actual-usage line? quick mock: sparkline 95p util per-rack, banded by tenant commit.

els: fyi this ties to the eviction blips we tracked — correlated with transient inlet spikes. if we can surface "therm-hysteresis windows" (time since last >80C) it'd help ASG scale decisions.

mscott: rough PromQL ideas: 
```
# 95p GPU util per rack
quantile_over_time(0.95, nv_gpu_utilization{job="nvml"}[1h])

# inlet temp moving max 5m
max_over_time(node_temp_inlet_celsius{job="sensors"}[5m])

# simple vram fragmentation ratio
(nvml_gpu_vram_total_bytes - nvml_gpu_vram_allocated_bytes) / nvml_gpu_vram_total_bytes
```

mscott: For alerts, try a composite rule: inlet_temp_max > 78 for 3m AND gpu_util_95 > 70 for 6m -> tag as "sustained thermal pressure" (route to oncall + k8s-allocator). That should reduce noise for single short spikes.

samir: love the composite rule. Also want a panel that overlays tenant-commit vs active-inference-threads to show wasted reserved capacity. maybe a stacked bar: reserved slots (dashed) vs live usage.

gabi: UI notes: add an annotation stream for evictions (kube_eviction_total) and for autoscaler events. Add a derived metric: "therm_window_start" = time since last inlet >75C (can be done as recording rule). Then a single heatmap with x=time y=rack color=therm_window_duration.

ops-bot: deploybot: grafana/dashboard/changesets queued by @gabi. PR draft: https://git.internal/r/grafana/dash/therm-slotting (refs #4321) :construction:

elaine: small question — do we want to surface per-region power budget headroom? some regions have caps and that's been tripping fallbacks. can add a header KPI for region power_headroom_percent.

samir: yes please. KPI + per-region 99p latency of scheduling (so we can see when power headroom correlates with scheduling delays).

mscott: I'll draft the alert playbook lines and example queries in the PR. Keep thresholds soft to start, enable auto-snooze for 1h if eviction rate drops after mitigation.

samir: thanks all. I'll add a small eval set to verify dashboard catches the blips.

gabi: tagging eng-sre for visibility: @eng-sre :eyes:
